messages:
Omar Khan: quick heads-up — want to lock a dry-run cadence for the next HW roadmap wave (H100/H200, B200, MI300, Gaudi). proposing week of May 11 for vendor + SI tabletop. main asks: firmware gating, marketplace embargo windows, SI image readiness, and press slot conflicts. who can commit reps? :eyes:
Priya Rao: +1. can we compress to a 2-day focused dry-run (vendor signoff + SI integration) then follow-up rollback/press check the next day? less ops overhead. :thumbsup:
Lucas Martinez: SI checklist (short): image artifacts, CV test models, perf smoke, canary scripts, runbook. we should freeze test prompts and perf targets ahead of time.
Chen Li: infra notes — region capacity for canary (us-west1 / eu-west1), fallback routing if MI300 nodes are constrained, autoscale thresholds. need quota requests in cloud marketplaces by 5/5.
Alice Park: adding a simple draft plan, happy to iterate:```
Dry-run outline (week of 2026-05-11)
- Day A (Mon): vendor firmware + image signoff, manifest upload to staging marketplace
- Day B (Tue): SI integration smoke + perf baseline, KV cache warmup, namespace isolation test
- Day C (Wed): limited canary in US region, rollback verification, tracing validation
- Day D (Thu): embargo/press handshake, enable GA gating flags, final handoff to comms
```
Ann (NVIDIA): FYI firmware team expects a patch candidate by 2026-05-09 EOD. we can do image push to staging on 5/10. monitoring hooks (telemetry + nvtx traces) will be included. I can confirm rep availability for 5/11.
Omar Khan: perfect — Ann can you also confirm whether the patch requires any power/thermal lab retest or just a software microcode stamp? if lab needed, that shifts press window.
Ann (NVIDIA): it’s a microcode stamp only; no HW retest expected. lab not required.
Lucas Martinez: pinging SI partners — can you have container images + test models by 5/8? we’ll need them to run the perf baseline.
DeployBot: scheduled dry-run job created: dryrun/gpu-roadmap/1767894321 at 2026-05-11T09:00:00Z (owner: Omar Khan)
Priya Rao: Comms question — press embargo windows: do we want a soft embargo (internal partners) or firm embargo (public outlets)? leaning soft for initial wave so we can surface early metrics.
Alice Park: agree soft embargo for the canary, firm embargo only after cross-cloud smoke passes. we should publish a short embargo calendar to partners by 5/7.
Chen Li: noted on quotas — I’ll open marketplace quota tickets for US/EU regions today and tag @marketplace-eng. please add minimum request numbers (Lucas).
Lucas Martinez: minimum numbers: 4 nodes per region for canary, 12 nodes per region for full SI perf ramp. adding to the ticket now.
Ann (NVIDIA): vendor ops will allocate a small standby team for the window. I’ll share a contact list and an escalation flow.
Omar Khan: next steps: (1) Ann confirm rep list (by EOD 5/1), (2) SI to deliver images by 5/8, (3) marketplace quotas requested by 5/5, (4) comms embargo calendar draft by 5/7. please react with :thumbsup: when you own an item.
Priya Rao: got it — I’ll own comms embargo calendar. :thumbsup:
Lucas Martinez: I’ll own SI image collection and perf targets. :thumbsup:
Chen Li: I’ll file quota tickets and coordinate fallback routing. :thumbsup:
Ann (NVIDIA): vendor contact list + escalation flow coming shortly. :thumbsup:
Omar Khan: thanks everyone. will schedule a 30-min dry-run kick tomorrow to confirm times across timezones. :calendar:
MarketplaceBot: heads-up — staging marketplace slots available 2026-05-10 through 2026-05-14, please claim via https://marketplace.example/reclaim.
Omar Khan: noted — claiming slots. final note: if any vendor firmware slips, fallback plan is to route to H100/H200 compatible variant (no new microcode) and mark as "soft degraded" in release notes. keep that option on the table. :information_source:
Priya Rao: copy — add rollback play to runbook with communication templates for partners and press.
DeployBot: dry-run meeting created: dryrun/gpu-roadmap/1767894321/kick at 2026-05-04T16:00:00Z (invite sent)
Lucas Martinez: will run SI smoke on 5/10 in staging and share logs. :mag:
Chen Li: ping me if we need extra tracing hooks — I’ll add a short checklist to the runbook.
Omar Khan: closing — will post final checklist and invite list after the kick tomorrow. thanks all. :raised_hands:
